scope: Offline synthetic AI claim extraction and relation assessment, versions v0.3–v1.1
research_status: Engineering evidence only; no independently adjudicated evaluation and no production deployment
authorship_note: A synthesis of documented Manifold Grace experimental milestones. This index does not replace immutable source results or prove originality or external influence.
interpretation: Each decision links an observed failure/constraint to an architectural response, an explicit falsifiable follow-up and an evidence gate. These are design recommendations, not validated improvements.

records.question: Can a low-cost verifier match editorial claim labels without relying on unsupported guesses?
records.observation: v0.3 abstained on all 15 synthetic pairs; v0.4 lexical rules matched 14 of 15 in-sample editorial labels.
records.limitation: In-sample labels authored with development; abstention is not the same as understanding.
records.design_decision: Retain refusal/abstention as a first-class outcome, score answer coverage and label agreement separately.
records.next_test: Hold rules fixed and evaluate previously unseen claim wording with full confusion counts.
records.release_gate: A new, independent sample and predefined metrics are needed before claims about generalisation.

records.question: Do lexical rules transfer across wording changes?
records.observation: Frozen v0.4 heuristic matched 5/30 new editorial labels; abstained on 28/30.
records.limitation: Synthetic authored evaluation; a low score could include uncertainty in editorial labels.
records.design_decision: Introduce explicit sentence-to-typed-proposition extraction; do not infer unsupported attributes from word overlap.
records.next_test: Partition extraction, comparison and abstention failures on separately labelled examples.
records.release_gate: Compare against a frozen lexical baseline on a new dataset, without editing labels after observing predictions.

records.question: Where does end-to-end failure occur: extraction or typed reasoning?
records.observation: v0.8 challenge: 12/18 end-to-end adjudicated reference relations matched versus 18/18 typed-input reasoner matches; six missed relation labels resulted from paraphrase abstention.
records.limitation: Editorial challenge labels were still developer-authored and typed-input scoring uses supplied reference structures.
records.design_decision: Keep extraction and reasoning as separate modules with independent traces and error codes.
records.next_test: Use blind independent field labels, then compare field accuracy, relation accuracy and combined coverage.
records.release_gate: Independent label adjudication and an explicit abstention policy before any accuracy claim.

records.question: What evidence is required to separate software contract checks from semantic validity?
records.observation: Twelve fictional pairs, two blank reviewer forms and adjudication workflow prepared; independent reviews completed: zero.
records.limitation: A reviewer template and outreach do not create independent reference labels; original cases were assistant-authored.
records.design_decision: Freeze input cases and predictions, independently obtain two reviewers' annotations, adjudicate disagreement and protect raw reviews.
records.next_test: Measure inter-reviewer agreement and unresolved fields before using adjudicated labels as a reference.
records.release_gate: Two genuine independent completed reviewer forms and a signed-off annotation protocol.

records.question: Can the implementation be reproduced and are releases justified?
records.observation: 100/100 metamorphic invariants on 20 exposed fictional pairs; v1.1 audit preserved five frozen component hashes and 109 regression tests passed.
records.limitation: Implementation consistency does not establish semantic accuracy, source truth, security or deployment readiness.
records.design_decision: Maintain immutable baseline checksums, regression tests and separate approval gates for evaluation and security.
records.next_test: Run independent semantic evaluation, then production-specific threat modelling and security testing only if deployment is proposed.
records.release_gate: Do not declare general model reliability, independent verification or deployment readiness from synthetic software tests.

failure_to_action.investigation: Inspect field extraction, not only end-to-end label
failure_to_action.response: Compare an alternate extractor against the frozen baseline; preserve abstention.

failure_to_action.investigation: Inspect schema/value semantics and comparison logic
failure_to_action.response: Revise typed rules and test exclusive, numeric, scope and temporal cases separately.

failure_to_action.investigation: Inspect source provenance and whether time/scope support the claim
failure_to_action.response: Abstain, seek provenance or human review; never substitute repeated model output for source evidence.

failure_to_action.investigation: Inspect ambiguous wording and annotation rubric
failure_to_action.response: Record both labels, reconcile transparently, flag unresolved cases.

failure_to_action.investigation: Inspect version control, dependencies, fixture changes and execution logs
failure_to_action.response: Block reproducibility claims; restore/fix and rerun frozen checks.
